data.one_liner: A Dart command-line tool for generating type-safe Dart references for assets.
data.what_it_does: Spider scans your asset folders and generates Dart classes with static const variables pointing to your assets. This eliminates string typo errors and provides IDE auto-completion. It also supports generating verification unit tests and watch modes for automatic rebuilding.
use_when: You want type-safe references to project assets instead of hardcoded strings
You manage a large number of images, vectors, and fonts in your Flutter app
avoid_when: You prefer dynamic asset loading or standard string paths
strengths: Prevents typos when referencing asset paths in code
Supports custom configuration via YAML or JSON
Provides watch modes to regenerate references automatically on file changes
weaknesses: Requires running a CLI tool or keeping the watcher active
data.setup_notes: Activated globally via pub (dart pub global activate spider) or installed via Homebrew.
